issues.title: Update admin pages for Collaborative Editing
issues.body:
* [ ] Add Special Channel for Collab edit and Collab response
* [ ] New RFI participation toggles

We can currently add "rfi" and "mapping" special channels from the `Settings - Channels` page.

We're going to change that - to remove "rfi" and add the two separate collaboration channel types:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/127169978-455719a5-b3f7-4238-bbbe-e5ba2b46d16c.png)

The channel definition now includes an optional `CollabOptions` item:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/127172047-b071a7ff-0b50-4a32-ae50-aebd24daa21b.png)
Note: adding a "collaborative working" channel creates this `CollabOptions` element:
### Collab-Editing
```
const options: CollabOptions = {
  mode: 'edit',
  returnVerbs: ['Endorse', 'Request Changes'],
  startWithReview : true,
  originatorsSeeChanges: false,
  extraColumns: []
}
```

### Collab-Response
```
const options: CollabOptions = {
  mode: 'response',
  returnVerbs: [],
  startWithReview : false,
  originatorsSeeChanges: true,
  extraColumns: []
}
```

When this is a collaborative editing channel, we now have two extra toggles in the participants entry:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/127171052-1f1ed7c9-6423-4cda-81e0-d72ca99e17c7.png)

We need to provide edit controls for them (just used Red for mockup, normal text color to be used):
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/127171841-9b9fbb14-9d5e-403c-9c41-f5136e26fb60.png)
